free_text: A repeat biopsy is indicated because the mpMRI demonstrated a PI-RADS score of 4, identifying a focal lesion measuring 12 x 8 x 10 mm in the right mid-peripheral zone. Although the PSA density was low at 0.02 ng/mL², the high-risk imaging finding outweighs the low kinetic factors, which aligns with the cohort criterion for repeat sampling after a negative prior biopsy. The evidence converged on the need for further tissue sampling.
